source_text: Parallel research reaffirmed broader health benefits, including a 10-fold reduction in urinary tract infections (UTIs) in infancy, lower incidence of human papillomavirus (HPV) and herpes simplex virus type 2 (HSV-2) infections (30-40% and 28-34% reductions, respectively), and decreased penile cancer risk due to reduced phimosis and chronic inflammation. [93]
